expo.name: Huddle
expo.//backgroundColor: Soft Minimal's `colors.screen`, which the TV letterboxes with and which shows through the gaps in the background image. Stated here so the native window is already right before any React view exists — otherwise a cold start flashes the platform default while the fonts resolve and TvLayout returns null. Kept honest by color-literals.test.ts, which is also why the value is written out: Expo transpiles app.config.ts and then requires it, so importing the token is not possible.

ios.//infoPlist: CALayer.allowsEdgeAntialiasing is false by default, and a layer carrying a transform is composited without antialiasing — so Boardwalk's ±1–2° sticker tilts turn every tile border into a visible staircase (measured: a rotated edge steps 2px per 50 rows with no intermediate pixel values, where Android feathers the same edge). This key turns edge antialiasing on app-wide. Apple documents a rendering cost; the TV screens are near-static, so it does not matter here. Only the TV app needs it — nothing in the Controller is rotated.
